digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler bridge preview/sync command and argparse handling
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must load active tickets once via ordinary dry-run differ and emit a single manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from that same pass, without invoking or reimplementing reconcile-check.
Canonical preview must be lock-free: it acquires no pass lock, calls no lock purge/steal/release ceremonies, and leaves repository and lock state byte-identical to baseline.

Argparse abbreviation path must be made impossible via allow_abbrev=False, causing abbreviated or unknown options to exit code 2 before any reads, locks, or mutations, while documented legacy options like --mode dry-run remain valid.

Legacy reconcile-check retains its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free diagnostic branch, bridge_state/reconcile-check.json artifact, and output/exit behavior unchanged.

Canonical preview and canonical sync emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope; canonical uncapped live includes manifest with exact applied/failed tally, while legacy uncapped LIVE callers retain historical tally-only/no-retained-manifest contract.

Legacy routes (direct-engine --mode dry-run/live, library reconcile, MCP reconcile, older workflows) preserve all existing observable behavior; canonical presentation disposition is threaded as an explicit request field and does not infer from Mode.
